readme: Reviewed, legitimate reasons a store that appears to carry a commodity is NOT on the board. audit-coverage-gaps.ps1 skips these so it only alerts on NEW/unreviewed gaps. Remove an entry to force a re-review (e.g. once we can price it). NOTE: blueberries@Hy-Vee and blueberries@Fareway were removed 2026-07-12 - both are now priced per-ounce via the commodity's pint_oz (11.2 oz) dry-pint weight, so they belong ON the board, not here.
